note: R5 new-tests: proposed UI cases for the coordinator to add to pm/plan-merged/ui-cases.json. Fields `note` and `retire` are for the coordinator; strip `note` before merging. Cases with ui_mode ui-staging are not runnable on the demo build.

cases.title: In the demo book System shows the prototype's own checks and no Live checks card
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
expected: The doors under the counts are Working checks, Role permissions, System activity and Failed-write test.
The page has a card headed 'Not working'.
The page has a card headed 'Needs attention'.
cases.note: R5 item 1. Demo (FIXTURE_MODE=local) answers GET /api/system with an empty view, so the Live checks card renders nothing; verified on the 4 Oct build. Written as positive facts (D63).

cases.title: A seat without the system right has no System page and so no Live checks
steps: Press Tasneem Qureshi on the sign-in screen
expected: The menu ends with 'Teams' and then 'How the merge works'.
The menu has Today, Leads and Numbers.
cases.note: R5 item 1. The 403 'not-a-system-reader' branch (card hidden) is covered by vitest src/features/system/live-checks.test.tsx; in the UI the seat never reaches the page.

cases.title: An Investors-side seat has no System page either
steps: Press Harsha Bhat on the sign-in screen
expected: The menu ends with 'Teams' and then 'How the merge works'.
The menu has Today, Investors and Numbers.

cases.title: On staging, Sahil's System page opens with the Live checks card
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
expected: A card headed 'Live checks' shows counts in the form 'N working · N need attention · N not working'.
The card has a row 'Zoho API credits left'.
The card ends with 'Service-token expiry, cache load errors, the Zoho licence date and the last Zoho Sign event are not read here yet.'
cases.note: UNVERIFIED: staging only (live half of GET /api/system); not runnable in the demo build. The footer sentence is from SystemPage.tsx LiveChecks; the credits row key is from server/system/checks.ts.

cases.title: Granting a page: the confirmation says what starts and nothing else
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
expected: The panel says 'Jhalak starts reaching Leads' and that it appears on their rail with 'See it' and nothing else.
The panel offers 'Give Jhalak Leads' and 'Leave it as it is'.
cases.note: Converted from ui-todo (plan id TC-E14-004, ui-todo). Split in two: this checks the confirmation; TC-E14-028 the sign-in. The old 'menu = Leads, Profile' fact is changed: Profile is under Your account, not the menu (FACT CHANGE PROPOSED).

cases.title: After the grant, a by-grant person signs in to only that page
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
Press 'Your account' in the top bar
Press Jhalak Mehta on the sign-in screen
expected: The top bar names Jhalak Mehta.
The menu holds Leads.
The page is Leads.
cases.note: Second half of plan TC-E14-004 (new id).

cases.title: The IR Manager sees only her IRs and cannot give a seat above their own
steps: Press Tasneem Qureshi on the sign-in screen
Open the 'Role and reporting manager' section
expected: The Members list names Tasneem Qureshi, Rohit Deshpande, Kavya Nair, Nikhil Rao, Ananya Iyer and Vinay Shenoy.
Kavya Nair's Position dropdown shows IR Associate, and IR Manager in it is marked as above Tasneem's own access.
cases.note: Converted. FACT CHANGE PROPOSED: 'IR Manager cannot grant System to Sahil / Leads to Jhalak' is shown by absence: Tasneem's member list has only her IRs, so there is nobody to open. 'Make Kavya an IR Manager' shows IR Manager disabled 'above your own access' in Kavya's Position list.

cases.title: A manager change cannot make a loop: Tasneem's Reports-to list holds no one under her
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
Open the 'Role and reporting manager' section
expected: Tasneem Qureshi's 'Reports to' dropdown lists Nobody, Sahil Mohite, Harsha Bhat, Divya Kamath, Arvind Menon and Pradeep Ram.
Tasneem Qureshi's 'Reports to' dropdown currently shows Arvind Menon.
cases.note: Converted. FACT CHANGE PROPOSED: the case expected the refusal 'That would make a loop'. The Reports-to list never offers anyone under the person (Rohit/Kavya/Nikhil/Ananya are not in Tasneem's list), so the loop cannot be picked; the server refusal is covered by manager-change tests, not by a screen.

cases.title: A leaver's leads move to the successor in one step
steps: Press Tasneem Qureshi on the sign-in screen
Open the 'Temporary access and staff handover' section
Choose 'Kavya Nair · 6 owned leads' in the 'Receive this IR work' dropdown
expected: Nikhil Rao's row in Members is marked 'left' and reaches 0 screens.
Kavya Nair's row shows 8 leads.
The page says 'Removed member after handover, Nikhil Rao · 2 owned leads to Kavya Nair'.
cases.note: Converted (plan TC-E14-010). Uses the real labels: 'Receive this IR work' dropdown. 'Cannot sign in' is not asserted on screen (negative).

cases.title: Lend a page: Tasneem grants Kavya Numbers for 3 days
steps: Press Tasneem Qureshi on the sign-in screen
Choose 'Kavya Nair — IR Associate' in the 'To whom' dropdown
Type 'Covering the weekly review' in the reason box
expected: The Temporary access door reads '2 live'.
The page says 'Granted temporary access, Kavya Nair · Numbers (See it) · 3 days · Covering the weekly review'.
cases.note: Converted; first half (grant). Second half TC-E14-012b (Kavya's side). The 'switch on, open Numbers, banner' tail is not asserted: Activate access is not pressed.

cases.title: Kavya sees the lent Numbers page waiting to be switched on
steps: Press Tasneem Qureshi on the sign-in screen
Choose 'Kavya Nair — IR Associate' in the 'To whom' dropdown
Type 'Covering the weekly review' in the reason box
Press 'Your account' in the top bar
Press Kavya Nair on the sign-in screen
Press '2 lent to you' in the top bar
expected: The page offers 'Activate access' for the Numbers grant.
The Numbers grant reads 'Covering the weekly review'.
cases.note: Kavya sees '2 lent to you' and an Activate access offer.

cases.title: Ending a live grant revokes it at once
steps: Press Tasneem Qureshi on the sign-in screen
expected: The Temporary access panel says 'none live' and 'No active temporary access.'
The panel shows 'Previous grants · 3'.
cases.note: Converted. Needed an app fix: End access was a silent no-op (pages-a reducer swallowed revokeTemp); with the fix Tasneem's panel reads 'none live' and 'Previous grants · 3'. Kavya's sign-in half dropped.

cases.title: The failed-write test fails the next save and leaves the saved date alone
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
expected: The top bar says '1 save failed' with a Retry button.
The Period targets table shows September as 01 Sep → 30 Sep.
cases.note: Converted; the failed save shows only as '1 save failed · Retry' in the top bar. FACT CHANGE PROPOSED: the plan's 'The date was not saved…' message is not shown on the Plan page for a failed write (only for a refused date); the test-armed save is not shown with its own sentence.

cases.title: After the failed-write test, Retry saves the date
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
expected: The Period targets table shows September as 01 Sep → 29 Sep.
cases.note: Retry saves the date (Sep ends 29 Sep).

expected: The page says 'The end date must be on or after the start. The saved window is unchanged.'
The Total row still reads 01 Sep → 31 Dec.

cases.title: A new target is saved and the plan total follows
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
Type '60' in the 'September target units' box
expected: The Total row shows 203.
September's Paid cell shows 0 and is plain text.
cases.note: Converted. FACT CHANGE PROPOSED: the 'abc' step is not reachable on screen — the target box is a number box and a browser refuses letters in it; the case is reduced to typing 60 (Total becomes 203) and paid units having no box.

cases.title: Digital Infrastructure sets a recovery action on a red line
steps: Press Sahil Mohite on the sign-in screen
Press 'Set action' on the 'Hours a lead waits for an owner' row
Choose 'Coach the owner and re-run next week' in the 'The action' dropdown
Choose 'Tasneem Qureshi — IR Manager' in the 'The owner' dropdown
expected: The 'Hours a lead waits for an owner' line now shows 'Coach the owner and re-run next week'.
The line names Tasneem and a date.
cases.note: Converted. Needs the accessible-name fix on Set action / Change (aria-label includes the line's name): four identical 'Set action' buttons scored 0.52 on the pick.
